title: 2008 AMC 8 Problem 19
statement: Eight points are spaced at intervals of one unit around a \(2\times2\) square, as shown. Two of the \(8\) points are chosen at random. What is the probability that the points are one unit apart?

solutions.text:
Each dot has \(2\) dots that are one unit away from it.

Therefore, regardless of the choice of the first dot, \(2\) of the other \(7\) dots would be within one unit, so the probability is \(\dfrac 27.\)

Thus, the answer is B .
hints: Count the total number of unordered pairs of points.
There are exactly \(8\) adjacent unit segments around the square.
